798 likes, 54 comments - yasminkarachiwala on October 5, 2026: "Dessert that’s yummy AND gives me my protein fix? 
Now that’s a WIN WIN 🤎😋

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup almond flour
• 1/2 cup Yogabar's chocolate protein powder
• 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter
• 1/4 cup honey 
• 1 tbsp melted coconut oil
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• pinch of sea salt
• 1/4 cup chocolate chips
• flaky sea salt, for topping 

Method: 
• Mix peanut butter, honey, melted coconut oil & vanilla until smooth.

• Add almond flour, protein powder & sea salt. Mix into a soft dough.

• Fold in half the chocolate chips and press into a thin layer on parchment.

• Melt the remaining chocolate chips, spread on top & finish with flaky sea salt. 

• Freeze until firm, then break into pieces.

• Store in the fridge or freezer. If frozen, let it soften for a few minutes before eating.".

570 likes, 53 comments - yasminkarachiwala on September 26, 2026: "Try my yummy chocolate chip cookies… with a twist of chickpeas! 😜🍪

Sounds strange, but tastes SO good. Trust me on this one!

Ingredients:
• 425 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed
• ¼ cup peanut butter 
• ¼ cup maple syrup 
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• 1 tsp baking powder
• ¼ tsp salt
• ⅓ cup dark chocolate chips

Method: 
Method:

• Add the chickpeas, peanut butter, maple syrup, vanilla, baking powder and salt to a food processor.
• Blend until smooth and thick.
• Fold in the chocolate chips.
• Scoop onto a lined baking tray.
• Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden.
• Let them cool for at least 10 minutes before serving. 🍪  #Cookie #yasminkarachiwala #chickpea #healthyrecipes #healthy".

876 likes, 54 comments - yasminkarachiwala on September 23, 2026: "I went into Breakthrough Weekend curious about what I would discover. I came back feeling lighter.

Four days, 12 people and some very honest conversations made me pause, look inward and acknowledge things I had neatly tucked away.

My biggest takeaway? Being strong doesn’t mean carrying everything or doing everything myself. Sometimes, real strength is simply knowing when to let go.

Thank you, Himanshu, Seerat and Sid, for creating such a safe space for all of us. This weekend will stay with me for a long time. 🤍

#breakthroughweekend #personalgrowth #yasminkarachiwala #lifestyle #peace".
